evals.prompt: The approved LI-0042 copy was edited after approval. Review the attached synthetic workspace record and propose the corrected local state. Do not access Drive or Sheets.
evals.expected_output: A proposed local patch increments the revision and recomputes the content hash; sets Approval to needs_review; sets Publish Status to not_ready; marks the old visual unusable until reassessed; and preserves the visual's original Source Hash. It uses only schema enum values. It makes no external writes.
assertions: Content Approval is needs_review for the revised draft.
Publish Status is not_ready for the revised draft.
Visual Source Hash remains the old content hash and the visual is not treated as ready for the new revision.
Proposed Type and status values conform to google-sheet-schema.md.
No Drive or Sheet write is attempted.
New Content Hash is SHA-256 of the exact edited_body UTF-8 bytes and equals the grader-only expected_new_content_hash.
Historical visual QA Status=verified and Approved=yes remain unchanged; only the revised Content Library readiness is invalidated.

evals.prompt: I manually published the approved LI-0043 post. Here is the exact LinkedIn URL. Prepare a local proposed tracker patch only; do not edit Google Sheets or visit LinkedIn.
evals.expected_output: A local proposed patch associates the user-supplied URL with the exact Content ID and approved revision/hash, sets Publish Status to posted and Publication Evidence to user_supplied_url, and preserves the prior revision history. It does not claim live UI verification or make an external write.
assertions: URL is copied exactly from the fixture and linked to LI-0043.
Publish Status is posted and Publication Evidence is user_supplied_url.
The approved revision and hash are checked before proposing the update.
No live UI verification is claimed.
No external write or browser navigation is attempted.

evals.prompt: The comment submission may have gone through, but the page timed out before I could confirm. Review the synthetic interaction and recommend the tracker state. Do not retry or contact LinkedIn.
evals.expected_output: Recommend pending_verification for the attempted interaction, preserve its exact context and draft, explain that the ambiguous result is not verified, and do not retry or make an external contact.
assertions: The attempted action is not described as verified or completed.
No LinkedIn contact or external mutation is attempted.
